place: Harrat Khaybar volcanic field, Medina Province; Jabal Qidr scoria cone 4.3 km, Lava al-Qidr flow 7.7 km (OSM)
terrain: Basaltic lava field with scoria cones and pale comendite domes (Jabal Abyad, Jabal Bayda), about 12,000 km2, built over about 5 Myr; last eruption about 650 CE (Wikipedia).
access: Nominatim places the site in Khaybar district; the Umm Jirsan lava tube is about 125 km north of Medina (Live Science, search snippet only). Road access not checked: UNVERIFIED.
protection: No legal protection found; Jabal Qidr is on the IUGS 2022 list of 100 geological heritage sites, which is not a legal status (Wikipedia).
evidence_urls: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrat_Khaybar ; https://earthdate.org/files/000/004/123/EarthDate_395_C.pdf (search snippet only: Mars lava-tube habitats in general) ; https://www.slate.com/blogs/bad_astronomy/2010/12/02/guess_the_planet.html (search snippet only: ISS photo of Harrat Khaybar that looks like Mars)
why_moonlike_or_artefact: Plausible: young basaltic flows and cinder cones are the classic lunar-mare analogue setting; risk: the closed depressions may be lava-flow hollows and tuff rings rather than impact-like forms.
searches_run: Harrat Khaybar lunar analog OR Mars analog OR planetary analogue | Harrat Khaybar lava tube Umm Jirsan Mars base analog study

access: Remote; no road or settlement found within 15 km in OSM. UNVERIFIED.

place: Western Lut Desert (Dasht-e Lut), Shahdad District, Kerman Province; Kalut yardang field node 47 km (OSM)
terrain: Hyper-arid lowland at about 250 m (ranking.csv) in a desert of about 51,800 km2 whose centre has wind-carved parallel ridges and furrows over 150 km (Wikipedia). Depression share 3.9% of cells.
access: Kerman County, Shahdad District (Nominatim). Roads not checked: UNVERIFIED.
protection: Lut Desert inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List on 17 July 2016 (Wikipedia); whether this point is inside the property not checked (UNESCO page returned 403): UNVERIFIED.
evidence_urls: https://studio.m-anage.com/gsa/2017CD/webprogram/Paper292992.html (Kerber and Radebaugh 2017, GSA abstract: Lut yardangs as terrestrial analogue for Martian yardangs) ; https://mdpi.com/2071-1050/15/12/9677 (title only: Mars-like places in the Lut WHS; 403 when opened) ; https://www.ipgp.fr/~narteau/papers/P67.pdf (search result only)
why_moonlike_or_artefact: Likely artefact for the Moon: depressions and roughness here come from wind erosion (yardang corridors) and dunes, which have no lunar counterpart; the Lut is an established Mars aeolian analogue.
searches_run: Lut desert Kaluts yardangs Mars analog planetary analogue Iran

access: Commercial tours are generally accompanied by a military escort; five tourists were killed in an attack in January 2012 (Wikipedia).
protection: Not stated in the opened source: UNVERIFIED.
